title: Coproducts of finite separable etale field spectra are etale
statement: Let K be a field [def-pc-field-extension], let I be a set, and for each i in I let L_i/K be a finite separable field extension (finite and separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]). Then the coproduct morphism (coprod_{i in I} Spec L_i) \to Spec K is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism].

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 02GL (morphisms-lemma-etale-over-field), the converse direction in the proof: finite separable spectra are etale and disjoint unions of etale morphisms are etale; coproduct construction as in Schemes, Lemma 01JB

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family], the coproduct $X=\coprod_{i\in I}\operatorname{Spec}L_i$ exists with open coprojections $\iota_i:\operatorname{Spec}L_i\to X$ whose images are pairwise disjoint and cover $X$. The universal property gives a unique morphism $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ whose restriction along $\iota_i$ is the given morphism $\operatorname{Spec}L_i\to\operatorname{Spec}K$.

For every $i\in I$, the restriction $f\circ\iota_i:\operatorname{Spec}L_i\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ is etale by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-separable-extension-etale], because $L_i/K$ is finite and separable algebraic by hypothesis.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 02GL (morphisms-lemma-etale-over-field), finite separable spectra are etale

proof.text: The images of the $\iota_i$ form an open cover of $X$ by step 1, and each restriction $f\circ\iota_i$ is etale by step 2. Etaleness is local on the source by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-local-on-source], so $f$ is etale. This also covers $I=\varnothing$, when $X$ is empty, and $I$ a singleton, when $f$ is the given finite separable spectrum morphism.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 02GJ (lemma-etale-characterize), etaleness is local on the source
